rules: solver strategy is hidden behind one interface
rectangular rooms may use analytical fast path
arbitrary supported room shapes use numerical eigenmode solving
a perfectly rigid rectangular room uses the analytical cosine eigenbasis
open boundary patches invalidate the exact rigid-boundary eigenproblem
until a mixed-boundary numerical solver exists, rectangular open boundaries use an explicitly labelled mode-dependent leakage approximation
the open-boundary approximation removes modal energy according to field strength over the aperture and never solves exterior geometry
the analytical opening approximation must not be described as an exact mixed-boundary eigenmode solution
